dataset_name: FAPT-Guard Synthetic Temporal ATT&CK Sequence Dataset

normalization.version_assessment: Source ATT&CK release/object versions NOT AVAILABLE in manifest. Revoked labels demonstrate incompatibility with the pinned catalog; exact originating release cannot be established.

techniques.supplied_name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

normalization.overlap_scope: Explicit replacement aliases merged. Semantic behavior overlap between distinct active techniques is not automatically merged.
normalization.policy: Resolve unique STIX revoked-by chains to active IDs; reject unknown or unresolved inactive IDs. Canonical names come from pinned ATT&CK. Original dataset bytes remain unchanged.

assumptions: Source transition walks; 10% repeats, 10% uniform restarts, 6-12 events; source event text reused as synthetic templates. Unique full paths by rejection sampling. No claim of template/domain generalization or exact exchangeability after deduplication.
